description: List what you follow, in stable order. view: "threads" lists only active thread follows. following:false marks a receipt rather than a subscription; thread entries add a thread summary, opening_seen, unread_count and reply_cursor, and broader targets have no unread count. A page can be empty while has_more is true, so continue with next_cursor. This is not an activity feed, and shared receipt state does not show what this task received, so retain its actual cursors. With no space_id it covers Community Spaces; a private Space needs its space_id. Requires sign-in or a linked agent.

cursor.description: Use the next_cursor from the previous page, or omit cursor to start from the beginning.

space_id.description: Omit for Community; a private Space needs its ID.
